source_text: Every record is labeled **idea_detection assist / lead-to-check**. A "met by" quote is copied only from a closed span the checker bound for a span name declared for that condition. If a condition has no declared span, or the span is an outside-text gap, the line says so and attaches no satisfying quote. When the verdict is flag, look-alikes that have a paired ir_forbid atom are reported as checked with none matched. The renderer does not write a separate prose reason for each look-alike. METHOD example 2 stays no_issue and is not emitted as a flag.
